CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 8194(c)
S. I. Special Branch Statistics/
REPORT
Date September 19. 19 40.
Subject General Loong Yung 龍雲, Chairman of Yunnan Provincial Government,
carried to Chungking by General Chiang's plane.
Made by D. I. Fan Lien Tih Forwarded by D. S. I. Logan.

It has been learned from a usually reliable
source that General Loong Yung (龍雲), Chairman of
the Yunnan Provincial Government, was carried away from
the provincial capital (Kwenming) to Chungking by plane,
by General Chiang Kai-shek and General Fei Chung-shi.
Prior to his departure for Chungking, General Loong
was said to have received a telegram from General Chiang
Kai-shek telling him that he, in company with General
Fei, would arrive at Kwenming by air before noon of
September 10, for the purpose of inspecting the defence
works along the Yunnan-Annam border. On receipt of the
telegram, General Loong personally proceeded to the
aerodrome at Kwenming to welcome the Generals at the
stated time. Upon the arrival of Generals Chiang and
Fei, General Loong Yung was invited to go into their
plane to have a talk, and by means of this subterfuge
he was conveyed to Chungking in the plane.

General Loong Yung is a returned student from
France and because of the area under his control being
near to French Indo-China, he has been on good relations
with the French Authorities. The troops under his
control are said to be patterned on the French style,
with numerous French officers serving among them, their
armaments being all purchased from France.

On the outbreak of the current Sino-Japanese
hostilities in 1937, the various parties and cliques
pronounced their unification. General Loong Yung

日期 1940年9月19日。
主题 云南省政府主席龙云将军，由蒋介石将军的飞机带往重庆。
制作：侦探督察 范连迪（Fan Lien Tih） 转呈：副特别处主任 洛根（Logan）。

据一通常可靠的消息来源获悉，云南省政府主席龙云将军（龍雲）被蒋介石将军和费仲实（Fei Chung-shi，音译）将军用飞机从省会昆明带往重庆。据说在前往重庆之前，龙云将军收到蒋介石将军发来的电报，告知他将于9月10日中午前与费将军一同乘飞机抵达昆明，目的是视察滇越边境的防御工事。收到电报后，龙云将军亲自前往昆明机场，在指定时间迎接两位将军。蒋、费两位将军抵达后，邀请龙云将军进入他们的飞机进行谈话，并借此计谋将他用飞机带往重庆。

龙云将军是一名留法归国学生，由于其控制区域靠近法属印度支那，他与法国当局关系良好。据说他麾下的部队仿照法式编制，其中有众多法国军官服役，其武器装备均从法国购买。

1937年中日敌对行动爆发时，各党派和派系宣布统一。龙云将军

however maintained an indifferent attitude; not only
has he failed to despatch any of his troops to partici-
pate in the fighting but he refused the admission of
National Government troops into the Yunnan province.
(The National Government troops at present stationed
along the Yunnan-Annam border made their way through
the province of Kwangse.) Although the indifferent
attitude of General Loong Yung has long been repugnant
to the National Government, the latter has remained quiet
towards his attitude, because until after the fall of
France in the current European War, the National
Government had hopes of receiving assistance from France
and all military supplies from abroad, had to pass
through the province of Yunnan, of which General Loong
is the Chairman.

    Following the defeat of France in the European
war, the situation in the Yunnan-Annam border became
somewhat acute. General Loong Yung, however, still
maintained his indifferent attitude towards the
National Government. Lately, the National Government
is said to have learned that Wang Ching Wei is secretly
negotiating with General Loong for his joining the
peace movement. As a precautionary measure, and in
order to avoid an unfavourable development, General
Chiang Kai-shek has planned his removal from Kwenming
to Chungking as mentioned above.

然而却保持冷漠态度；他不仅未派遣任何部队参战，还拒绝国民政府军队进入云南省。（目前驻扎在滇越边境的国民政府军队是通过广西省进入该地区的。）尽管龙云将军的冷漠态度早已令国民政府反感，但后者对其态度一直保持沉默，因为直到当前欧洲战争中法国沦陷之前，国民政府仍希望获得法国的援助，且所有来自国外的军用物资都必须经过由龙云担任主席的云南省。

随着法国在欧洲战争中的战败，滇越边境的局势变得 somewhat 紧张（原文用词为acute，意为严峻/尖锐）。然而，龙云将军对国民政府仍保持冷漠态度。最近，据说国民政府获悉汪精卫正在与龙云秘密谈判，劝其加入“和平运动”。作为预防措施，并为了避免不利事态的发展，蒋介石将军策划了上述将其从昆明转移至重庆的行动。
